decisions.reason: The product was publicly launched and fits the firm's core safety footwear line, so with no reported sustained poor results, escalation of commitment favors persisting rather than dropping it.
Management has invested in and publicly committed to this product, and absent clear evidence of permanent failure, escalation of commitment makes a drop unlikely.
Because the firm has already invested and publicly presented the product, and no persistent disappointing results are documented, the escalation tendency leads to keeping it.
